tool: GmG bench F1 (genome_markers.py, megablast of tef1/rpb1/rpb2/CaM/tub2 against the FusariumID download)
method: in-silico barcoding: the FusariumID loci found in each BFD fusarioid assembly by megablast; distance = (mismatches + gap openings) / aligned length over the concatenated loci to the nearest FusariumID strain
call_rule: label when the nearest FusariumID strain over the concatenated loci is within distance 0.01; a tie between species keeps every name, ';'-joined
refresh: 2-3 times a year, after a FusariumID download (owner, PopSeq issue #33)
notes: the BFD fusarioid assemblies in GmG's table (2,111 rows); complexes from GmG crates/gmg-core/data/species_complexes.tsv (FusariumID 2026-06-23). FOSC species are 99.6-99.99% genome ANI apart: a FOSC label is reliable at the complex level, weaker at species level.
